title: Juicy Grilled Greek Morcilla Horiatiki
description: A rich and comforting Greek dish featuring morcilla, grilled to perfection and served in a hot pot vessel, sugar free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
Slice the morcilla into 1 inch thick rounds.
Grill the morcilla for 5 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
In a large bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, sliced red onion, and sliced cucumber.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar and extra virgin olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture and toss to combine.
To assemble the horiatiki, place a few slices of the grilled morcilla in the bottom of a hot pot vessel.
Top the morcilla with a spoonful of the tomato mixture, followed by a sprinkle of crumbly feta cheese and a few kalamata olives.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese and olives on top.
Serve the horiatiki hot, straight from the hot pot vessel.
